_comment: v2 pretrain (443M) on a free Kaggle T4 16GB (or P100): fp16 autocast + GradScaler (no fast bf16 pre-Ampere), gradient checkpointing and chunked cross-entropy to fit 4×1024 per micro-batch. 4×1024×24 = 98k tokens/step, same as the A100 config, but do NOT alternate T4 (fp16) and A100 (bf16) within one run without testing it (precision change mid-run; smol-training-playbook). Prefer A100 bf16; use this only if T4 is all there is. Muon's Newton-Schulz runs in bf16 (emulated on T4, once per optimizer step): smoke-test 20 steps before a long session.
